# Fixtures for `cur` (Windows cursor)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The images are
synthetic gradients and patterns; names, places and captions are fictitious.

Crafted files reproduce the format's structure (headers, IFDs, boxes, records) around
placeholder pixel data; whiff never decodes pixels. exiftool reads them as the format they claim to be.
